description: End-to-end interconnect billing order-to-cash workflow for telecom operators, covering agreement setup, traffic mediation, rating, billing, dispute management, settlement and reporting.

agreement_id.description: Identifier of an interconnect agreement covering products, rates, and terms.

order_id.description: Identifier of an interconnect service order.

traffic_batch_id.description: Identifier of a mediated traffic batch (e.g., CDR/UDR aggregation).

dispute_id.description: Identifier of a dispute raised against an invoice or traffic batch.

settlement_id.description: Identifier of a settlement or payment record.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, INR).

time_range.description: Generic time range object used for filtering.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: create_interconnect_agreement
functions.description: Create a new interconnect agreement with a partner, including products, rate plans, and commercial terms.

agreement_reference.description: External/legal reference for the agreement (e.g., contract number).

notice_period_days.description: Number of days notice required before termination.

direction.description: Traffic direction covered by the agreement.

rate_plans.description: List of rate plans for different products/regions.

tiers.description: Tiered pricing per destination or usage range.

min_duration_sec.description: Minimum billable duration in seconds for voice.

netting_enabled.description: Whether to net incoming and outgoing charges.

late_payment_interest_percent.description: Annualized interest rate for late payments.

functions.returns: Created agreement record including agreement_id, status, and version information.

functions.name: create_interconnect_order
functions.description: Create an interconnect service order under an existing agreement for specific products and destinations.

order_reference.description: External order reference provided by the partner or internal CRM.

services.description: List of interconnect services requested in this order.

rate_plan_code.description: Rate plan code defined in the agreement.

max_mps.description: Max messages per second for SMS.

traffic_profile.description: Expected traffic patterns for planning and credit checks.

expected_traffic_per_day.description: Expected average traffic per day in charging units (e.g., minutes, events, MB).

peak_factor.description: Ratio of peak to average traffic.

attachments.description: Optional document references related to the order (e.g., LOA, contract scans).

functions.returns: Interconnect order details including order_id, initial status, and validation results.

functions.name: activate_interconnect_order
functions.description: Validate and activate an interconnect order, performing credit checks and provisioning readiness.

activation_date.description: Requested activation timestamp. Defaults to now if omitted.

validation_overrides.description: Optional override flags to bypass specific validations with justification.

simulation_mode.description: If true, run validations without actually activating the order.

functions.returns: Activation result including new order status, activation timestamps, and any warnings or failed validations.

functions.name: ingest_traffic_batch
functions.description: Ingest and classify raw interconnect traffic (e.g., CDRs/UDRs) for a partner and agreement into a mediated batch.

source_system.description: Identifier of the network element or mediation system providing the records.

records.description: Array of raw traffic records. Schema is loosely typed to support multiple record formats.

volume.description: Generic usage volume (e.g., in bytes for data, count for SMS).

functions.returns: Created traffic batch details including traffic_batch_id, record counts, and ingestion quality metrics.

functions.name: rate_traffic_batch
functions.description: Apply rating to a mediated traffic batch based on the relevant agreement and rate plans.

rating_date.description: Timestamp used for selecting appropriate rate versions.

re_rate.description: If true, re-rate records even if previously rated.

ignore_invalid_records.description: If true, skip invalid records and continue rating.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate rating without persisting charges.

functions.returns: Rating summary for the batch including total charge, currency, record-level error stats, and links to detailed rated records.

functions.name: generate_interconnect_invoice
functions.description: Generate an interconnect invoice for a partner using rated traffic and applicable discounts within a billing period.

billing_period.description: Billing period for which to generate the invoice.

include_traffic_batches.description: Optional explicit list of traffic_batch_ids to include.

invoice_direction.description: Determines whether the invoice is to be sent to or received from the partner.

functions.returns: Invoice details including invoice_id, line items, totals, tax breakdown, and billing period coverage.

functions.name: get_invoice_details
functions.description: Retrieve complete details for an interconnect invoice, including line items, taxes, and related traffic batches.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Complete invoice representation with requested related entities and current status.

functions.name: raise_interconnect_dispute
functions.description: Raise a dispute against specific invoice line items or traffic batches, providing evidence and requested adjustments.

disputed_amount.description: Total amount being disputed in settlement currency.

items.description: Specific invoice line items or traffic batches being disputed.

reference.description: URL or system reference to the evidence artifact.

functions.returns: Dispute record including dispute_id, current status, and linkage to the invoice and affected items.

functions.name: resolve_interconnect_dispute
functions.description: Resolve an existing dispute by approving, partially approving, or rejecting it and generating corresponding financial adjustments.

resolved_amount.description: Amount to be adjusted following resolution.

functions.returns: Updated dispute record including new status, any created credit/debit notes, and adjustment references.

functions.name: record_interconnect_settlement
functions.description: Record settlement or payment against interconnect invoices, including netting and dispute offsets.

netting.description: Details of netting between receivables and payables.

netted_partner_amount.description: Amount offset by partner's invoices in opposite direction.

allocation.description: Optional allocation of settlement amount to specific invoices.

functions.returns: Settlement record including settlement_id, updated invoice balances, and netting details.

functions.name: retry_batch_rating
functions.description: Retry rating for a traffic batch that previously failed or was partially rated, with options for rollback and selective retry.

rollback_previous_charges.description: If true, rollback previously generated charges before re-rating.

custom_filter.description: Optional filter applied when retry_scope is 'custom_filter'.

functions.returns: Retry job status including counts of records re-rated, rollback details, and any remaining errors.

functions.name: rollback_interconnect_invoice
functions.description: Rollback an invoice and its financial postings, optionally retaining the underlying rated usage.

retain_rated_usage.description: If true, keep rated usage records but unlink them from the invoice.

reverse_gl_postings.description: If true, create reversing entries in general ledger integration.

functions.returns: Rollback confirmation including previous and new invoice statuses, reversed postings, and impact summary.

functions.name: list_interconnect_entities
functions.description: Utility function to search and list interconnect entities such as agreements, orders, invoices, disputes, or settlements with flexible filters.

status.description: Filter by one or more statuses relevant to the entity type (e.g., 'active', 'pending', 'closed').

date_range.description: Filter by creation or effective date depending on entity type.

include_totals.description: If true, include aggregate totals (e.g., invoice amounts).

functions.returns: Paginated list of requested entities with optional aggregate totals and lightweight summaries suitable for dashboards.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import interconnect o2c entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many interconnect o2c entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many interconnect o2c entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_bulk_export
functions.description: Export interconnect o2c entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across interconnect o2c entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for interconnect o2c events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for interconnect o2c notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more interconnect o2c entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to interconnect o2c on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a interconnect o2c operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending interconnect o2c change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending interconnect o2c approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a interconnect o2c entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a interconnect o2c entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a interconnect o2c entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a interconnect o2c entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for interconnect o2c activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a interconnect o2c view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to interconnect o2c entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given interconnect o2c payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a interconnect o2c entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: interconnect_o2c_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a interconnect o2c entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
